name: 60107 · Streamwood, IL
findings: ZIP 60107 (Streamwood) has 62 nonprofit organizations. 21 of them (34%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 15 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (32% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 60107 (Streamwood) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 60107 (Streamwood) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 28% of the typical level).
